source: recovered/include/viper_*.h, recovered/calibration/signals.tsv, recovered/{FUEL_IGNITION,ENGINE_STATE,IDLE_AIR,FUEL_FEEDBACK,INTERRUPT_TASK}_FINDINGS.txt, ecu-manual/research/{obd-requests,sci-commands-10-1B,sci-commands-1C-25}.md, emulator/sci_commands.json, emulator/INPUT_MAP.md; checked against the emulator 2026-11-09

gauges.name: Engine speed
gauges.confidence: exact; word is 8 counts per rpm (PID 0C verified). Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 0C; sci-commands-1C-25.md cmd 22 selector 01; viper_control_signals.h ENGINE_SPEED_EIGHTH_RPM

gauges.name: Coolant temperature
gauges.confidence: nominal raw-64 C, working (substituted on sensor fault) value. Emulator: follows AN1 only
gauges.evidence: FUEL_IGNITION_FINDINGS.txt 'nominal Celsius = raw-64'; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 05; obd-requests.md PID 05

gauges.name: Engine phase flags (40 = running, 80 = startup fuel phase)
gauges.confidence: bit field; named bits inferred from producers and consumers. Emulator: A0 (startup phase, not running)

gauges.name: Engine run/stop timer
gauges.confidence: counts, time per count not established; cleared at start/stall events, FFFF rolls to FF00. Emulator: counts up with engine stopped and was seen to restart once

gauges.name: Time since key-on
gauges.confidence: counts (+1 per 029AD6 tick, saturates FFFF); seconds per count not established. Emulator: counts up steadily

gauges.name: Calculated load
gauges.confidence: formula verified, meaning strong; FLAG: only recomputed on request (PID 04, SCI 14 5C, snapshot capture), so a plain RAM read is stale; wraps above 255. Emulator: 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Intake air temperature
gauges.confidence: nominal raw-64 C, working value. Emulator: follows AN0 only
gauges.evidence: FUEL_IGNITION_FINDINGS.txt 'F80A5/F80A6 nominal Celsius = raw-64'; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 1B; obd-requests.md PID 0F

gauges.name: Throttle position (absolute, % of 5 V)
gauges.confidence: verified; raw input byte, percent of sensor supply, not pedal travel. Emulator: follows AN2 (first select) only

gauges.name: Throttle position, working value
gauges.confidence: raw byte; absolute throttle after fault substitution. Emulator: equals F8036

gauges.name: Throttle above learned closed reference
gauges.confidence: raw byte = max(F80AD - F8803, 0); research says not an established percentage. Emulator: tracks AN2 minus reference

gauges.name: Learned closed-throttle reference
gauges.confidence: raw byte, retained RAM. FLAG: emulator holds 02, research documents seed ROM 2611 = 38

gauges.name: Manifold pressure
gauges.confidence: nominal raw*105/256 kPa (PID 0B scaling, strong). Emulator: follows AN3 (second select) only
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 0B; FUEL_IGNITION_FINDINGS.txt 'Calibrated MAP byte'; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 0B

gauges.name: Manifold pressure sensor input
gauges.confidence: raw converter high byte before calibration. Emulator: follows AN3 (second select) only
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 0B source; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 2E/40; INPUT_MAP.md

gauges.name: Barometric pressure estimate
gauges.confidence: inferred role, no PID anchor; nominal MAP scale. Emulator: copies MAP with engine stopped, falls back to ROM 3D9F (F0) when MAP is low
gauges.evidence: FUEL_IGNITION_FINDINGS.txt 'F8804 probable barometric-pressure estimate'; calibration/signals.tsv; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 0F

gauges.name: O2 right upstream (bank 1)
gauges.confidence: OBD-anchored 0.02 V per count of the high byte (strong); OBD itself clips to 1.00 V at raw >= 40, and reads 2.4 % over pin volts if the byte is a plain 0-5 V sample. Emulator: follows AN3 (first select) only
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 14; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 02; FUEL_FEEDBACK_FINDINGS.txt signal table

gauges.name: O2 left upstream (bank 2)
gauges.confidence: OBD-anchored 0.02 V per count of the high byte (strong); OBD itself clips to 1.00 V at raw >= 40, and reads 2.4 % over pin volts if the byte is a plain 0-5 V sample. Emulator: follows AN4 (first select) only
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 18; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 2F; FUEL_FEEDBACK_FINDINGS.txt signal table

gauges.name: O2 right downstream
gauges.confidence: OBD-anchored 0.02 V per count of the high byte (strong); OBD itself clips to 1.00 V at raw >= 40, and reads 2.4 % over pin volts if the byte is a plain 0-5 V sample. Rear sensor reporting is disabled in this calibration (PIDs 15/16 refused). Emulator: follows AN5 (first select) only
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 15/16 (same x4 encoding); sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 3F; INPUT_MAP.md

gauges.name: O2 left downstream
gauges.confidence: Read by the same oxygen threshold tracker and paired-oxygen monitor as the other three, in the slots used for bank 2; the cavity (C3-29) is by elimination.

gauges.name: Short-term fuel correction, bank 1
gauges.confidence: signed; one count = 1/384 = 0.2604 % of fuel (verified arithmetic 011588..011636; consistent with PID encoding). Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: FUEL_FEEDBACK_FINDINGS.txt section 2; obd-requests.md PID 06; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 56

gauges.name: Short-term fuel correction, bank 2
gauges.confidence: signed; one count = 1/384 = 0.2604 % of fuel (verified arithmetic 011588..011636; consistent with PID encoding). Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Long-term fuel correction, bank 1
gauges.confidence: signed; one count = 1/384 = 0.2604 % of fuel (verified arithmetic 011588..011636; consistent with PID encoding). Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: FUEL_FEEDBACK_FINDINGS.txt section 2; obd-requests.md PID 07; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 0E

gauges.name: Long-term fuel correction, bank 2
gauges.confidence: signed; one count = 1/384 = 0.2604 % of fuel (verified arithmetic 011588..011636; consistent with PID encoding). Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: FUEL_FEEDBACK_FINDINGS.txt section 2; obd-requests.md PID 09; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 31

gauges.name: Fuel value group A (injector pulse width 1)
gauges.confidence: raw word; time units not established. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped. Group is not proven to be a bank

gauges.name: Fuel value group B (injector pulse width 2)
gauges.confidence: raw word; time units not established. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped. Group is not proven to be a bank

gauges.name: Startup (cranking) fuel value
gauges.confidence: raw word; time units not established. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Base fuel map result
gauges.confidence: raw word; time units not established. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Injector offset (candidate battery compensation)
gauges.confidence: raw signed word = 4*F826F + 179; time units not established. Emulator: 0113, driven by the stand-in supply value

gauges.name: Fuel system status, bank 1
gauges.confidence: bit field copied to PID 03 (bits 01/02/04/08); bank 2 writer differs from J1979 one-bit rule. Emulator: 00, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 03 and section 8 item 2; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 3B

gauges.name: Fuel system status, bank 2
gauges.confidence: bit field copied to PID 03 (bits 01/02/04/08); bank 2 writer differs from J1979 one-bit rule. Emulator: 00, engine stopped
gauges.evidence: obd-requests.md PID 03 and section 8 item 2; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 57

gauges.name: Final spark advance
gauges.confidence: exact half-degree counts on the normal path; sentinel/override states are not angles. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Base spark map result
gauges.confidence: nominal half-degree scale, before corrections. Emulator: rests at 0, engine stopped

gauges.name: Idle-air motor position, requested
gauges.confidence: software count named motor steps (0..210, ROM 3963), not a measured valve position. Emulator: moves with coolant (AN1) only

gauges.name: Idle-air motor position, tracked
gauges.confidence: software count named motor steps (0..210, ROM 3963), not a measured valve position. Emulator: moves with coolant (AN1) only; cold-init seed is 223 (ROM 0815)

gauges.name: Idle speed target
gauges.confidence: word is 8 counts per rpm, same scale as engine speed (verified). Emulator: moves with coolant (AN1) only, 824 rpm at 52 C

gauges.name: Vehicle speed
gauges.confidence: 64 counts per mph in the filtered word; the byte F80A4 = word/32 is the OBD PID 0D value (km/h = raw x 206/256). Checked in the emulator against generated pulse trains.

gauges.name: Supply / charging voltage value
gauges.confidence: raw byte; volts per count and exact identity unconfirmed. FLAG: supplied by the co-processor, which the emulator fakes, so the emulated value is fiction (reads D6)
gauges.evidence: FUEL_IGNITION_FINDINGS.txt 'Voltage scale/identity of F816E'; sci-commands-10-1B.md 14 index 0A; INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS.txt

gauges.name: Charging target
gauges.confidence: raw byte, same domain as F816E; physical scaling open. Emulator: 00

gauges.name: Battery temperature sensor input
gauges.confidence: raw sensor byte, no temperature conversion recovered. FLAG: supplied by the co-processor, which the emulator fakes, so the emulated value is fiction (reads DC)

gauges.name: Engine speed / road speed ratio
gauges.confidence: Filtered rpm/mph ratio the skip-shift logic uses to recognise first gear (92-115 counts). Reads about 105 in 1st and 20 in 6th in the emulator.
